scope: Versioned public-source catalog, metadata-admission records and upgrade queue. This file does not bundle unreviewed candidate data or grant a spatial registration.
policySummary: Only public digital sources with stable access records may enter the acquisition queue. Public availability is not permission to re-bundle or to call an author-space coordinate a project registration.

sources.title: BrainGlobe allen_cord_20um 3.0

provenance.primaryCitation: Fiederling et al. 2021; BrainGlobe Atlas API

rights.note: BrainGlobe AWS source is CC0; the upstream SC_atlas_P56 record is CC BY 4.0. Keep both attribution records with every derivative.

content.spinalCoverage: reference volume, not a cell census

sources.admissibleUse: Pinned local reference anatomy and sampled display planes.
prohibitedClaims: A sampled plane is not an observed specimen.
The reference alone does not register a cell, SWC, or evidence entity.
Atlas AP position is not a curated named spinal segment in this release.
nextChecks: Preserve the source and derivative manifests
Keep display transforms separate from registration transforms

sources.title: NeuroMorpho.Org adult mouse spinal-interneuron exemplars

rights.note: CC BY 4.0 plus repository terms. Cite the original reconstruction paper, NeuroMorpho.Org RRID, and Tecuatl et al.

sources.admissibleUse: Topology-QC-checked morphology examples in their reported local frames.
prohibitedClaims: A local SWC frame is not an atlas coordinate frame.
Five examples are not representative of all interneurons.
Morphology does not establish a synaptic edge list.
nextChecks: Use the official API for metadata
Require source-specific QC before adding each additional SWC

sources.title: SpinalJ processed example data

rights.note: Landing-page CC BY 4.0 metadata is recorded; file-level reuse and derivative decisions remain pending until a candidate-file manifest is audited.

content.spinalCoverage: example dataset with source-specific section series

sources.admissibleUse: Metadata-audited source-local registration-engineering benchmark candidate; no candidate file, transform or registration has been admitted.
prohibitedClaims: A metadata audit is not a data acquisition or a file-level inventory.
A benchmark transform does not register the current evidence entities.
A successful visual overlay is not validation.
Do not transfer the transform to NeuroMorpho SWCs.
nextChecks: Acquire and pin a file-level inventory, dimensions, spacing, orientation, checksums and transform provenance
Hold out landmarks before any REG proposal
Pin a reproducible software tag or commit rather than substitute the current repository state

sources.title: Cano-Gomez et al. mouse spinal-cord spatial and multiomic resource

rights.note: Accession availability does not settle derivative distribution rights or identify a project-space transform.

content.spinalCoverage: cervical, thoracic, lumbar and sacral study-specific samples

sources.admissibleUse: Condition-bounded source-local observations after specimen, pixel-size, orientation and cross-modality-key audit.
prohibitedClaims: This preprint is not a project registration by default.
Author-space coordinates are not the BrainGlobe coordinate space without a validated transform.
Do not call a cross-study label transfer a same-cell multimodal observation.
nextChecks: Audit stable specimen IDs and coordinate metadata
Require independent held-out error before proposing REG

sources.title: Russ et al. harmonized mouse spinal-cord cell-type atlas

rights.note: The CC BY 4.0 article and its pinned Supplementary Table 1 support the bundled derived marker crosswalk with attribution. Separate processed objects still require an object-level record before bundling.

content.lifeStage: postnatal reference with adult spatial validation context
content.spinalCoverage: type-level atlas; not per-cell spatial registration

sources.admissibleUse: Pinned 69-population type-level marker crosswalks with developmental and adult evidence kept as separate conditions.
prohibitedClaims: A molecular cluster is not an individual cell xyz position.
Postnatal taxonomy does not silently become adult geometry.
Marker overlap does not establish a unique circuit family.
nextChecks: Reconcile source-table, narrative and correction-state label evidence before any narrow transfer
Document label-transfer confidence and unresolved mappings for any additional processed object

sources.title: STARmap PLUS adult mouse CNS atlas — lumbar spinal-cord slice

rights.note: A study portal and Zenodo record make a public lead, not an asset-level redistribution decision. Record selected-object terms before any bundle or derivative.

modalities: STARmap PLUS targeted in situ sequencing
content.spinalCoverage: one coronal lumbar spinal-cord slice among 20 CNS slices from three mice

sources.admissibleUse: Metadata-only eligibility audit for one source-local adult lumbar spatial dataset after its exact object, specimen, units, axes, coordinate origin and rights are pinned.
prohibitedClaims: One lumbar source slice is not a whole-spinal-cord atlas or interneuron census.
Source-local cell coordinates are not BrainGlobe coordinates without a validated transform.
A targeted panel does not establish a complete transcriptome, morphology or connectivity.
nextChecks: Record an exact SCP or Zenodo object identity, file inventory, checksum and asset-level terms
Require specimen, slice, unit, axes, origin and gene-panel metadata before display
Keep any admitted coordinates source-local until a separate registration gate passes

sources.title: Tabulae Paralytica spinal-cord injury atlas

rights.note: Start with processed accession records. File-level rights, sample metadata and checksum are required before bundling.

content.spinalCoverage: model- and condition-bounded, including mid-thoracic injury contexts

sources.admissibleUse: Explicit injury-, time-, severity-, sex-, drug- and model-bounded state evidence.
prohibitedClaims: A Visium spot is not one interneuron.
Mid-thoracic injury data do not represent C1-S3.
Cross-condition averages must not erase injury-model differences.
nextChecks: Select a processed subset with full condition metadata
Model a spot or aggregate separately from cell-level observations

upgradeQueue.title: SpinalJ registration reproducibility benchmark
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A source-local reproducibility report with native spacing, transforms, landmark split, held-out error and no transferred cell registration.
acceptanceCriteria: Processed inputs and checksums are pinned
Training and held-out landmarks are disjoint
Physical-space error is calculated and reported
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: The data lack a reproducible transform, landmarks, or file-level reuse basis.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: The completed metadata audit does not convert current SYN entities or OBS-local SWCs into REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Cano-Gomez source-local spatial adapter audit
upgradeQueue.deliverable: Specimen-aware source inventory recording pixel scale, orientation, coordinate origin, cell IDs, modality links, terms and missing transform information.
acceptanceCriteria: Every displayed object retains a specimen ID
Coordinate units and orientation are explicit
Preprint status remains visible
Any reported thin-plate-spline method remains source-local and explicitly lacks an independently verified held-out error until a pinned artifact is reviewed
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: The release lacks stable cross-modality keys or reproducible coordinate provenance, or presents the preprint method report as a project registration.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: Remain source-local OBS or author-space results until independent registration validation passes; the reported study method does not create REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Molecular taxonomy crosswalk
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A version-pinned 69-population marker and label crosswalk that keeps lineage, transmitter, molecular identity and projection class as separate axes.
acceptanceCriteria: A source table URL, bytes and SHA-256 are recorded
Ambiguous mappings remain explicit and no prototype entity receives an exact Russ identity
Developmental context is not collapsed into adult geometry
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: A label transfer is presented as a unique identity, adult segment assignment or coordinate.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: This is type-level molecular evidence, not a spatial registration or same-cell multimodal join.

upgradeQueue.title: Injury-state condition adapter
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A schema-validated, metadata-only condition index that keeps GSE234774 sample labels, GSE230765 RNA/ATAC labels, modality and aggregation level distinct while source-file bodies remain unacquired.
acceptanceCriteria: Every displayed group names its GEO accession, source modality and aggregation level
Spatial section labels remain distinct from cell-level records
No source body, processed metadata, local file hash, coordinate, same-cell link or registration is admitted
Literal source labels and their interpretation boundaries are exportable
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: The adapter pools incompatible injury models, expands an abbreviation without source metadata, labels a spot as an interneuron, or promotes a series label into a cell state or treatment effect.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: The released index is source-metadata-only; it creates no numerical analysis, C1-S3 generalization, same-cell linkage, coordinate or REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Legacy NeuroMorpho expansion pointer — superseded by UPG-030 / UPG-030A
upgradeQueue.deliverable: Historical 0.4 pointer only; all new morphology-census implementation and acceptance decisions move to research queue UPG-030 and its UPG-030A child rather than creating a second expansion track.
acceptanceCriteria: The frozen 0.4 source entry remains limited to its five bundled exemplars
UPG-030A separately reports query-indexed, direct-file-audited, admitted and quarantined denominators
Original-study, NeuroMorpho.Org and repository citations remain mandatory
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: This legacy pointer is treated as an active independent work item, a biological census, an independent-animal denominator, or permission to place source-local coordinates into the atlas.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: Supersession changes planning ownership only; it does not modify frozen 0.4 assets, create a representative census or connectome, or create REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Public-source release-admission service
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A deterministic browser-local review and exportable receipt for the frozen SpinalJ 0.7 and Cano-Gomez 0.8 metadata manifests. It records declared publisher URLs/checksums and unresolved rights review while keeping every source object not admitted.
acceptanceCriteria: Only frozen manifest format/source pairs are accepted
Publisher metadata is recorded separately from local verification and asset-level authorization
Every receipt remains not admitted, with 0 acquired, bundled, locally hashed, transformed or registered source objects
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: Metadata completeness, a source URL, a publisher checksum or a catalogue record is presented as object possession, reuse authorization, a biological conclusion or a registration.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: The implemented service evaluates only locally supplied metadata against frozen catalogue rules. It does not authenticate a publisher assertion, acquire or inspect a source object, calculate a local checksum, grant rights, transform coordinates, establish a source-to-project relationship or create REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Independent curator adjudication gate
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A locally generated, version-locked adjudication packet that compares at least two independent curator feedback files for the same distribution version, release-manifest hash, human-reported package digest and zero-registration boundary while preserving every response and dissent.
acceptanceCriteria: At least two independently identified curator records match the exact distribution, manifest hash and one human-reported ZIP SHA-256
Each record reports ZIP verification and an explicit verdict; the browser does not claim to independently recalculate the original archive digest
A named adjudicator records a non-promoting defer, return-for-revision, or next-private-review disposition; disagreements and unable-to-assess outcomes remain visible
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: A count of downloaded forms is treated as approval, reviewers assess different package identities, an unverified or mismatched digest is silently accepted, or an unresolved disagreement is collapsed into acceptance.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: Adjudication packets review engineering and evidence boundaries; they do not acquire public data, authorize public release, establish biological truth, or create REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Tabulae source-checksum and rights gate
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A public object-level manifest for the header-observed GEO processed metadata object, recording a source checksum and an asset-level rights decision before any deliberate acquisition or adapter work.
acceptanceCriteria: The exact GEO object URL, bytes, format and source checksum are independently recorded
Asset-level reuse and redistribution permissions are recorded without relying on repository accessibility alone
Condition, aggregation level and coordinate missingness remain explicit
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: A locally inferred checksum, generic repository availability, a spot-level record, or a metadata-row identifier is presented as an admitted cell-level source object.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: This gate can document one public source object only; it does not download a body, create a local SHA-256, authorize reuse, establish a cell identity, or create REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Russ taxonomy version-and-adult-context reconciliation
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A schema-validated curator reconciliation dossier for the pinned marker-table receipt, paper narrative, two official corrections and adult-lumbar validation context before any narrower molecular label transfer is shown.
acceptanceCriteria: Every cited statement identifies its source object or article version
Both official correction records are linked and their stated scope remains visible
No correction is presented as a Supplementary Table 1 content rewrite unless a source says so
Adult-lumbar validation and postnatal transcriptomic reference contexts remain separate
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: A marker rank, legacy label or correction is silently substituted for a curated one-to-one entity identity.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: Reconciliation improves provenance only; it creates no spatial coordinate, same-cell pairing, connectivity edge or REG.

upgradeQueue.title: STARmap PLUS lumbar source-coordinate eligibility audit
upgradeQueue.deliverable: One version-pinned SCP or Zenodo object manifest that records source URL, specimen and slice identity, cell-coordinate units, axes, origin, gene-panel scope, checksum and asset-level rights before any source-local display is proposed.
acceptanceCriteria: The exact public object and its object-level terms are recorded
Specimen, lumbar-slice identity, coordinates, units, axes and origin are explicit or rejected as missing
The targeted gene panel and source-local coordinate authority remain attached to every derived record
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: A portal landing page, one source slice, a targeted gene panel or a visual overlay is presented as a full spinal atlas, a complete transcriptome, a validated project transform or REG.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: A future admitted display remains source-local OBS; it creates no whole-spine census, morphology, connection, same-cell join or REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Tabulae object and compatible-analysis admission gate
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A version-pinned, asset-level reviewed object inventory and analysis plan for one processed Tabulae object, including sample metadata, terms, checksum, coordinate/aggregation fields and a condition-compatible comparison rule. The current local 2D viewer is only a filename-gated browser session, not that admission.
acceptanceCriteria: The exact source object, metadata version, checksum and asset-level rights decision are recorded
Every proposed contrast prespecifies compatible injury model, level, time, severity, sex and treatment fields or is rejected
Cell, spot and aggregate records use separate schemas and preserve missingness
Any source-local coordinates retain units, axes, origin and held-out transform validation requirements
A local viewer never fetches, bundles, uploads, persists or promotes source content
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: A generic GEO landing page substitutes for object-level rights, sample labels are treated as full metadata, an incompatible condition pool is hidden, or a spot/aggregate becomes a cell, project coordinate or REG.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: This gate may admit a reviewed public object for a bounded source-local adapter only; the current local session does not make a whole-spine atlas, prove a treatment effect, create a same-cell join, transfer an SWC, create a 3D reconstruction or create REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Tabulae cross-section source-frame and 3D eligibility gate
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A curator-reviewed, specimen-aware audit that can establish whether any multiple Tabulae spatial sections have a source-provided physical frame, acquisition order, scale, orientation, cross-section identity and asset-level permissions sufficient for a bounded source-local 3D proposal.
acceptanceCriteria: Each candidate section has a stable source object, specimen and condition identity, native units, axis direction, origin, image-to-spot linkage and recorded missingness
Section order and inter-section geometry are source-supported rather than inferred from sample-label numbers
Source checksum and asset-level reuse decisions are recorded for every selected object
Any proposed 3D transform has disjoint held-out landmarks and physical-space error before curator review
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: A numeric section label, a visual stack, a synthetic spacing, a condition group or a browser overlay is treated as observed inter-section geometry or a project registration.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: This research watch can evaluate eligibility only; it does not create a 3D reconstruction, whole-spine atlas, source-to-project transform, cell identity, treatment effect or REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Tabulae multi-section source-local interpretation and concordance gate
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A curator-reviewed analysis protocol defining when independently selected Tabulae source-local sections may be compared qualitatively or quantitatively, while preserving specimen identity, condition compatibility, native coordinates and a strict no-alignment/no-3D boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: Every retained section has a stable object/specimen/condition identity and source checksum/rights record
The protocol distinguishes visual side-by-side inspection from any numerical comparison
A numerical comparison prespecifies compatible injury model, level, time, severity, sex, treatment, assay and aggregation level or rejects the pair
Any future spatial correspondence has a declared transform and held-out physical-space validation
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: Independent local sessions, label order, image similarity, spot count or side-by-side display are misrepresented as spatial correspondence, 3D evidence, a cell-level comparison, treatment effect, transform or REG.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: The implemented comparison board remains source-local 2D only; it does not align, normalize, order, stack, quantify, join cells, infer a treatment effect, create a source-to-project transform or create REG, and cannot align local sessions into a project registration.

upgradeQueue.title: Metadata-only RO-Crate provenance externalization gate
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A browser-local RO-Crate 1.3 detached metadata export that maps one catalogued public source at a time into a machine-readable external HTTPS reference without claiming that an underlying source asset is included.
acceptanceCriteria: Every external reference preserves its public-source ID, accession, version, stable URL, access date, rights status and acquired-versus-unacquired state
The export pins RO-Crate 1.3, emits its metadata descriptor and root Dataset, and passes deterministic structural checks before browser download
The detached document explicitly distinguishes its one external web data entity from bundled project assets and carries source-specific scientific limits
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: A metadata package silently downloads or embeds an external source object, treats a URL or publisher checksum as proof of local possession or reuse permission, drops a missingness field, or labels author/source coordinates as a project registration.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: The implemented detached provenance export describes metadata only; it does not acquire, embed, bundle, publish, validate biological truth, transform coordinates, establish a source-to-project relationship or create REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Public-source research-question feasibility planner
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A browser-local planner and exportable receipt that map a research question's selected evidence axes only to declared, source-specific package routes or an explicit no-qualified-route result.
acceptanceCriteria: Each selectable axis maps to one or more declared source-specific routes or an explicit package-coverage gap
A multi-axis question reports whether one route supports all selected axes; otherwise it preserves the separate-source/no-join boundary
The planner exports local planning metadata only and makes no remote request, file acquisition, object inspection, coordinate transform, biological analysis or registration claim
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: The planner treats two source cards as a same-cell join, changes a package-coverage gap into biological absence, promotes a metadata lead to an admitted source object, or implies an atlas registration.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: The planner supports study design only. It does not acquire, inspect, hash, transform, align, combine, analyze or bundle a source object; it does not authorize reuse, establish biological truth, infer a same-cell relationship or create REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Two-lane evidence and public-source provenance trace
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A browser-local, exportable trace that keeps frozen Research MVP evidence references and declared public-source feasibility routes in two separate, typed lanes.
acceptanceCriteria: The research lane exposes declared entity, claim, condition, statement and source references
The public-source lane exposes only selected planning axes, declared routes and catalogued source metadata
The interface and receipt explicitly state that no cross-lane edge, source acquisition, coordinate transform, same-cell relation or registration is created
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: A shared label, co-display, visual adjacency or common source name is used to imply a source-object link, same-cell/same-specimen relation, biological conclusion, coordinate transform, reuse authorization or REG.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: The trace is an immutable browser-local reference map. It does not acquire, inspect, hash, transform, align, combine, analyze, persist or bundle a source object; it does not infer biological truth, establish a cross-study identity or create REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Cross-lane relationship admission gate
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A browser-local, curator-reviewable metadata-only proposal composer for a possible future cross-lane relationship, requiring object identity, asserted relation type, source rights, coordinate authority, independent evidence basis, and explicit rejection reasons before any implementation is considered.
acceptanceCriteria: Each emitted proposal names two immutable release records and one narrowly typed candidate relation
A proposed identity, spatial, or transform relation requires stable object IDs, source-frame metadata, asset-level rights, and a predeclared independent validation plan
Every emitted proposal remains visible as not admitted and cannot alter the trace, source status, entity identity, or registration count
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: A shared label, curator preference, visual overlap, source URL, classifier output, or single-study observation is accepted as a cross-lane edge, same-cell relation, coordinate transform, reuse authorization, or registration proof.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: The implemented proposal composer is a non-promoting review gate only. It does not acquire, inspect, hash, transform, align, combine, analyze, persist or bundle a source object; it does not establish a cross-study relation, change evidence, grant reuse rights or create REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Source-assertion provenance and evidence-locator gate
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A browser-local assertion-provenance composer and JSON receipt for the two frozen metadata-manifest formats. Each receipt records a declared unacquired object or explicit unknown, one required check, typed claim scope, evidence locator, source state, reviewer and date without granting object admission.
acceptanceCriteria: Each emitted assertion names a declared unacquired object or an explicit unknown subject
The composer distinguishes publisher-asserted, curator-transcribed and unresolved fields but cannot label a field locally verified
Each receipt retains a typed evidence locator, responsible reviewer and review date while remaining not locally verified, not admitted and at 0 REG
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: A URL, landing page, metadata manifest or curator transcription is treated as proof of object identity, file possession, asset-level rights, biological truth, a cross-study relation or a registration.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: The implemented composer records curator-supplied metadata attribution only. It does not acquire, inspect, authenticate, hash, bundle, authorize, transform, align, combine, analyze or persist a source object; it does not validate biological truth, establish a source-to-project relationship or create REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Asset-level authorization and reproducible local-verification gate
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A browser-local, curator-reviewable authorization-and-verification plan composer for the two frozen metadata-manifest formats. Each plan fixes a declared unacquired object, version, intended use, requested rights review, evidence locator, planned acquisition/checksum/content-scope stages, curator and date without authorizing any action.
acceptanceCriteria: Each exported plan names one fixed declared unacquired object and version, links one assertion identifier, and retains its declared source checksum without calling it locally verified

The five planned stages—identity, object-specific rights review, authorized acquisition record, local checksum verification and content-scope validation—remain explicitly planned and separately auditable
Each plan remains not authorized, not locally verified, at 0 REG, and distinct from biological validation, coordinate transformation, cross-study linkage and registration
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: Public accessibility, a landing-page URL, a publisher-declared checksum, a repository-wide licence or a curator transcription is treated as authorization to acquire, redistribute, transform, join or register an object.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: The implemented composer records an authorization-and-verification plan only. It does not authenticate an assertion, authorize reuse or redistribution, acquire, inspect, hash, bundle, publish, transform, align, combine, analyze or persist a source object; it does not determine biological truth, establish a cross-study relationship or create REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Independent authorization-evidence packet and local-verification execution gate
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A browser-local independent authorization-evidence packet composer for the two frozen metadata-manifest formats. Each packet links one declared unacquired object, an authorization-plan identifier, proposed independent reviewer, typed evidence locator, requested scope and five independently reviewable execution stages without authenticating a decision or authorizing an action.
acceptanceCriteria: Each exported packet names one fixed declared unacquired object and version, links an authorization-plan identifier, and distinguishes an independent-review request from an authenticated decision
Authority identity, object-specific terms/scope, retrieval conditions, local integrity comparison and content/retention review remain explicitly planned and separately auditable

Each packet remains not authenticated, not authorized, not executed, not locally verified, at 0 REG, and distinct from biological validation, coordinate transformation, cross-study linkage and registration
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: A public URL, publisher checksum, generic repository licence, plan receipt or implementation convenience is treated as independent authorization, object verification, data-retention approval, biological truth, transform evidence or REG proof.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: The implemented composer prepares a curator-facing evidence packet only. It does not authenticate an independent decision, authorize access, acquire, inspect, hash, retain, bundle, publish, transform, align, combine, analyze or persist a source object; it does not determine biological truth, establish a cross-study relationship or create REG.

upgradeQueue.title: Separately approved local-verification execution and retention SOP
upgradeQueue.deliverable: A proposed, separately approved controlled-execution SOP for one object-specific authorization record: approved retrieval boundary, isolated checksum comparison, content-scope review, retention/audit record and downstream no-transform/no-registration separation.
acceptanceCriteria: A future SOP begins only after a separately authenticated independent authorization record names one exact object, version, rights statement, scope, responsible authority and storage boundary
Actual retrieval, checksum comparison, inspection and retention evidence are independently auditable, quarantined from the public review package, and cannot overwrite publisher assertions
Any locally verified object remains separate from biological truth, coordinate transformation, cross-study linkage and registration
upgradeQueue.rejectIf: A draft packet, public accessibility, generic licence, source checksum, local convenience, or similarity of content is treated as authorization to retrieve, retain, transform, join, redistribute, infer biological truth or create REG.
upgradeQueue.scientificBoundary: This is a research-watch design item only. It does not authenticate authorization, acquire, inspect, hash, retain, bundle, publish, transform, align, combine, analyze or persist a source object; it does not determine biological truth, establish a cross-study relationship or create REG.
